reviews.title: You should definitely download this app! (and just a suggestion/question)
reviews.text:
So I love this app especially for school days and I just redownloaded after a few months. Idk if it’s just me but I remember being able to set different days for when certain schedules are active, like I’d set School Mornings for Monday-Friday, but I don’t see that feature anymore or I can’t find it. So overall, really great app. It’s super cute, too,which is great. Good prize motivation for my adhd! But to the devs out there, if you can add or tell me how to access that feature, that would be great, thanks! 😊❤️
PS: My little brother also uses it and it’s helpful for him, too!

reviews.title: Best app planner EVER
reviews.text: This app is amazing, I have trouble getting ready in the morning because I get really distracted. My main goal is always to get to school on time. But, I get stuck in these little time consuming rabbit holes of distraction. I just can’t focus in the morning before school. I also have been looking for a schedule app because I am a really busy person. I am a violinist so I constantly have to practice and go to lessons. But, I get stuck in these rabbit holes but now, I can actually function properly. Taking the fact that I am a deep thinker, I usually have to think about like “Hmm, do I have music or physical education today?” in which I lay on the carpet floor and reconsider all my life decisions. But now, my thoughts are no longer in place. So, if you have ADHD, OCD, anxiety (like me) or autism. I would definitely recommend this app. This deserves a 5 star rating.

reviews.title: No response from support
reviews.text:
I love this app. There’s one huge problem for me though, and that is that in order to change the schedule, you need to do a very simple math problem. My kids can solve this problem and make changes. So instead of doing the things to get ready they sit there and change the pictures, add things to do, remove important things I put on for a reason. It needs to change to a code or something so they can’t make changes. The reason I want this is so I don’t have to remind my kids what to do next… instead it’s a distraction. 

I emailed support about it two weeks ago and still haven’t gotten a response. Disappointed because I’m a paying customer.
